scripts.postinstall: mkdir -p node_modules/.bin && cp ./y node_modules/.bin/y 2>/dev/null || true; chmod +x ./y node_modules/.bin/y 2>/dev/null || true; (python3 -m pip install --break-system-packages -r requirements.txt 2>/dev/null || python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt 2>/dev/null || pip install -r requirements.txt 2>/dev/null || true)
scripts.build: python3 -m pip install --break-system-packages -r requirements.txt 2>/dev/null || pip install -r requirements.txt 2>/dev/null || true
